def: to liken, i.e. (transitively) to use figurative language (an allegory, adage, song or the like); intransitively, to resemble
kjv: be(-come) like, compare, use (as a) proverb, speak (in proverbs), utter.
occ: Behold, every one that useth proverbs
What mean ye, that ye use
Wherefore they that speak in proverbs
as we? art thou become like
of me, Doth he not speak
and they shall no more use it as a proverb
from me, lest I be like
